description: A site on Whitehall Road, now under Rheims way. A concentration of 'votive' objects were identified and have been used to posit the location of a temple or shrine. No structure has been found, but it is a very comparable location to the Augustine House site.
bibliography: Frere, S, P Bennett, J Rady, and S Stow. “Canterbury Excavations: Intra- and Extra-Mural Sites 1949-55 and 1980-84.” The Archaeology of Canterbury 8 (1987): 45.

Helm, R, and et al. Outside the Town: Roman Industry Burial and Religion at Augustine House Rhodaus Town Canterbury. Canterbury Archaeological Trust Occasional Paper 10. Canterbury Archaeological Trust, 2014.
